steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Is everyone okay?

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: We took cover in time, thanks for the warning... *cough*, Janie, what about you? You in one piece?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I'm okay. Outcast covered me proper.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: But... what happened outside?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I hear lots of screaming... and the children...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Jane, don't go outside yet! All of you, stay low and stay in cover. Get away from the windows!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: An explosion of this scale always comes in waves—

steps.name: Operator Fred
steps.text: Aarrrggh! M-My leg... The bookshelf's got my leg pinned...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Will, give Fred a hand!

steps.name: Operator Fred
steps.text: Ha... thanks, mate. I can move now.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Are you bleeding anywhere?

steps.name: Operator Fred
steps.text: I'm fine. Just a little bit.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Do we have a first aid kit? Take that acute infection inhibitor right now!

steps.name: Operator Fred
steps.text: Huh? Lass, I got a gash on my leg 'cause of the splinter, that's all.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: No, you don't get it.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Right now, you're at the highest possible level of infection risk. Did you see the black crystal that smashed through the windows?

steps.name: Operator Fred
steps.text: M-My god... I...

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: Is that Active Originium...?!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: That it is.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: You mean, all the black stuff that's blanketing the streets... All of it?!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I'm afraid so.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I... I can't believe it...

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: D-Doesn't this mean the whole city's in terrible danger?!

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Dammit! Lass, we've gotta hurry and rescue the townsfolk! We're short on time, but we need to save as many as we can!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Any objections?

steps.name: Operator Shredder
steps.text: I figured Oliver would raise his hand.

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Mock me all you want later, but get your arse moving now and get that first aid kid packed! Fred, you're hurt. Stay here and coordinate the rest of us! Will, go home and check on your parents—

steps.name: Operator Will
steps.text: I can go with the rest of you...

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Don't be an idiot, boyo. Family's more important than work! Bring some medicine with you, and check on your neighbors once you're done helping your family!

steps.name: Operator Will
steps.text: Thank you, Boss...

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Shredder, old mucker, looks like you and I've got a few more streets to take.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Don't forget about me, Oliver. It may only be a temporary arrangement, but I am an operator under your wing nonetheless.

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Lass, don't be absurd.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I'm being serious. Leave the District Ten and its surroundings to me.

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: That's the epicenter. It's way too dangerous...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Do we have a choice? Give me a temporary set of comms too. We'll give each other progress reports.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I'm going too...

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Er, Janie, this rescue op's not a playdate, and you've not gone through training like the rest of us. You don't need to put yourself in harm's way.

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Whose bloody idea was it to dump all this Active Originium on a town anyway?! They've got to be out of their minds!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: They bombed so much land in such a short period of time... Whoever planned this attack must've at least ten brand new ground suppression howitzers.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: That much artillery...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: I watched the battle over the past two days from afar, and there are some formidable Casters among the so-called rioters. That gives their force a certain degree of stealth capability.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: —But that's not enough to hide so much materiel coming into town, especially not from the garrison's watchful eyes.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: And they're not stupid enough to point their cannons at a city block they finally managed to bring under their control. As if they'd blow up all the locals, their own men included.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: You—you mean...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Jane, you know the answer.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: No, it can't be...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: You mean our men annihilated a city block? It was us... who killed all those townsfolk, condemned countless more to death by Oripathy?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: It's the barracks.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: They know they can't win a war with the Tarans on the other side. With no way to tell friend from foe, they'll take them all down in one shot, even the common folks.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: And they used a dirty bomb precisely because it saves them the trouble later on. The Infected get rounded up, and that gives them the most righteous excuse to dispose of the Tarans.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: They used... the people as a tool like that? Isn't the Victorian Army meant to protect its citizens?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You're agitated. I can tell. That's because you've got a kind heart that most soldiers lack.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Over the last few centuries, the Victorian Army has trampled all kinds of nations and peoples across the world, and it was never out of the goodness of their hearts.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Now I see why the townsfolk thought the rioters were in the right...

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: But they're just as ready to use innocent lives for their own gain. They got different masks on, but the faces under them are just as ugly. What's the difference?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Then—Is Rhodes Island the only side doing what's right?

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: How well do you know Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I trust Uncle Oliver and everyone else here, and I've known to trust you ever since the day we met.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: And how well do you know me?

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Lass, why be so intense? Janie here needs some time to take this all in...

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: It's okay, Uncle Oliver. I know what Outcast is trying to tell me.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I really am... thankful you took me in when I had nowhere to go.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: And I really am—still confused... Whenever I pick a side, someone tells me I don't belong.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: But, at least for the time being, I know what I have to do.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: Please let me come with you. I want to help the injured outside as best I can.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Even if some of them were throwing rocks at you, chasing you away just a minute ago?

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: It's just as you said. I can't stand by and watch evil happen over and over—This has nothing to do with what side I choose.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: You hear that, Oliver? You're the officer-in-charge of County Hillock. Will you let Jane Willow join our ranks, if temporarily?

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: I—I've got no problem with that!

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: We've got all the first aid kits packed. Janie, you can come with any one of us.

steps.name: Janie
steps.text: I'm going to the central block too...

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Haha, so you're going with the Lass? Phew, and I thought you'd be scared of her after all that just now.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Operator Oliver
steps.text: Nothing!

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: If everyone's ready, let's go.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Remember, your own safety comes first. You've got lots of contaminated ground to look out for, and enemies to keep in mind too.

steps.name: Outcast
steps.text: Given the situation, forces on either side won't be too friendly to us.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Mr. Chef! Mr. Chef—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Ugh, where to start? We've got wounded everywhere.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: No, I have to find Chef! He should be around here. I need to get him out of town!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I... Ugh, what's got my leg?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: A... a hostile?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: No, you're out like a light. No threat to me.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Kill... me...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Later. Let me move this rock that's got your leg pinned first.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huff—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: There we go! Oh, it's all mush... And these black crystals... Looks serious.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Kill... me!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: I can't...! The Infected... are dirty... I mustn't be sullied like that!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, wheesht. Nothin' wrong with hangin' in there to live another day, is there?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: You... don't get it...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: This is a fate... worse than death...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Alright, I don't get it, fine then. I'm lookin' for someone. No one's got help for you now.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Mr. Chef! Mr—

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Hngh...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What are you tugging my leg for this time? This... This apron! Mr. Chef—!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (The rock crushed Chef too. No wonder I couldn't find him.)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (The intel's still here.)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: (He tried his best to protect it till the very end. I can tell.)

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Mr. MacMartin. I don't know your real name—but I will remember you for what you've done.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Rest in peace, my friend in arms.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Your bravery won't go to waste.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: And you. I need to thank you, nameless hostile.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I should give you what you want. But I can tell, you'll be gone soon even if I don't do a thing.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Any last words?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: ...The Leader.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: You're about to peg out, and your leader's what comes to mind?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: Hah... hahahaha!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: We... will give rise... to... a fire of rebirth!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Where're you looking a—
More and more enemies are pouring in through the ruins.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Reinforcements?!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The cannons didn't do a thing...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Captain... They're all gonna be in danger!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I need to regroup with them—

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: My mission's a failure. In that case, takin' the communications center's our last chance!
